data.description: This processed color image of Jupiter was produced in 1990 by the U.S. Geological Survey from a Voyager image captured in 1979. Zones of light-colored, ascending clouds alternate with bands of dark, descending clouds.  http://photojournal.jpl.nasa.gov/catalog/PIA00343
